practitionerSettings.title: Settings
practitionerSettings.intro: Your account, your language, and the policies your practice runs on.

saved.password: Password changed. Every other session has been signed out.
saved.email: Check the new address for a confirmation link — nothing changes until it's confirmed.

errors.pw-rate: Too many attempts — give it fifteen minutes and try again.
errors.pw-short: The new password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.email-rate: Too many requests — try again in an hour.
errors.email-format: That doesn't look like an email address.
errors.policy: Those policy numbers didn't look right — nothing was changed.

account.heading: Account
account.emailNote: Nothing changes until you confirm from the new address — a link (valid 24 hours) goes there, and a notice goes to your current address.
account.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Changing it signs you out on every other device.
account.signoutHint: Ends every session on every device, including this one — sign in again after.

language.heading: Language & appearance
language.label: Language
language.hint: Your portal language — AI-drafted output will follow it too.
language.themeHint: Daylight or Dusk — remembered on this device.

practice.heading: Practice
practice.billingHint: Your price book, packages, and the ledger.
practice.availabilityHint: Hours, session length, buffers, and video links.
practice.paymentsHint: Your payment connection — money goes directly to you.
practice.planHint: Your platform plan — card, invoices, and receipts.
practice.toolsHint: Draw tools and lookups for work in the moment.
practice.agreementsHint: Send, sign, and keep the sealed record — for both of you.
practice.signatureHint: Draw it once — or upload a photo or scan of your real signature — and it's applied automatically, with the date, whenever you sign or countersign a document.
practice.intakePreviewHint: See the intake exactly as your client will — nothing is saved.
practice.referralsHint: Your founding-partner code, and who has come in through it.
practice.messagesHint: How the Open Line sets expectations.
practice.assistLabel: Email clients after an assist session
practice.assistHint: A quiet note — “Valentina helped with your account today” — each time you enter their portal to help. Recommended on; the visible line in their settings stays either way.

policy.heading: Session-change policy
policy.proportionality: Heads-up: the late fee is higher than the current session rate — counsel flagged that a late-change fee should stay a reasonable proportion of the session price.
policy.autoHint: Unchecked, you'll be prompted each time instead.
policy.summary: More than {hours}h notice → free. Less → {fee}. No-shows → {fee}.

deletion.heading: Deletion requests
deletion.promise: The promise: a response within 7 days, deletion completed within 30 days of confirmation.
